nodes.name: Set Status W trakcie

Fire-and-forget: success output dead-ends, error -> Alert Status Failed (onError:continueErrorOutput) so a status-write failure never blocks the answer. Reads taskId from the trigger item. Post Reply (Stage C) flips the field to 'Zakończono' at the end.

nodes.name: Context OK?
nodes.notes: Layer-B reliability guard (silent-failure mandate, 2026-06-11). Call Assemble Context has alwaysOutputData=true so an empty context build still emits an item; this IF gates on a non-empty `prompt`. true -> Call Execute LLM; false -> Alert Context Empty (CRITICAL). Without it, a 0-item Assemble return silently skipped Execute LLM + Post Reply and the run still reported success (the exact failure on task 869dm1z8y).

nodes.name: Session OK?
nodes.notes: Gates whether the session produced anything to publish. ADR-063 fix (2026-06-27): under deliver_output the agent's answer lives in output_blocks and final_message_text/output_message is EMPTY when it delivers cleanly via the tool (no chatter). The old check (output_message notEmpty) dropped those valid tool-delivered answers -> WARN agent-orchestrator/managed-session + no Post Reply. Now TRUE when output_message is non-empty OR (delivered_via_tool AND output_blocks non-empty). FALSE (genuinely empty: no text AND no blocks) still -> Alert Session Empty.

nodes.name: Call Write Cost Field
nodes.notes: Managed lane cost write-back (parity with the bare lane's in-workflow field write). Sums agent_runs.cost_pln for the task and writes CU '[AI] Koszt akcji [PLN]'; returns {total} used for the comment footer. Runs AFTER the session logged its cost row so the SUM includes it. onError=continueRegularOutput + the sub-workflow is internally fail-soft, so a cost-sync hiccup never blocks Post Reply. NOTE: managed image-gen cost rows now carry the real clickup_task_id (agent-supplied tool arg, ADR-057 amendment) so they ARE included in this cumulative per-task SUM. The PER-EXECUTION image cost for the comment footer is computed separately by the downstream Sum Execution Image Cost node (windowed by since_ts, ADR-060) — this SUM stays the all-time task total for the CU field.

nodes.name: Sum Execution Image Cost
nodes.notes: ADR-060: per-execution image cost for the managed footer. SUMs agent_runs.cost_pln for THIS task over the managed image-gen rows (triggered_by='image_mcp', migration 036) created since Resolve Lane's since_ts (captured before the session ran), i.e. only THIS execution's images. Feeds Call Post Reply (Managed).total_image_cost_pln so the footer = session text cost + this run's images. Cumulative CU field (Write Cost Field, by task, all-time) is unchanged. onError=continueRegularOutput + alwaysOutputData so a transient DB miss falls back to image_total 0 (Build/Post still run). Known limit: two concurrent runs on the SAME task overlap windows and can cross-count (rare; ADR-060).

parameters.query:
select coalesce(sum(cost_pln), 0) as image_total, count(*) as image_count
from agent_runs
where clickup_task_id = $1
  and triggered_by = 'image_mcp'
  and created_at >= coalesce(nullif($2, '')::timestamptz, now());

nodes.name: Img Cost Missing?
nodes.notes: ADR-060 reliability guard: TRUE when images WERE delivered this execution (render image_manifest non-empty) but the windowed image cost summed to 0 -> the per-execution image cost (footer + this-run attribution) is understated. Causes not already caught by the generation-time image-mcp/missing-task-id WARN: clock skew on since_ts, a triggered_by/filter mismatch, or all image rows landing null-task. Side branch -> Alert Image Cost Missing (WARN), never blocks Post Reply.

Complements the generation-time image-mcp/missing-task-id WARN by catching the since_ts-window/skew/filter failure modes. onError=continueRegularOutput so the alert can't break the run.

nodes.name: Build Floor File Map
nodes.notes: ADR-061 Block 2b (Option E): the managed floor dropped the eager Files-API upload (input_images_json='[]' below), so the agent_input_file_map that generate_image reference_refs resolves against is no longer populated by Upload Input Images. Rebuild it here from Stage A's image_blocks_json: each top-level image -> a row keyed by source_ref (the attachment id the agent passes as a reference_ref) with url = the ClickUp attachment URL the external generator fetches. file_id is synthetic ('att_'+source_ref) — only the PK; the resolver matches source_ref OR file_id and returns url. Mirrors the {file_id,url,mime,source_ref} shape Upload Input Images persisted (url=ref). Empty (no images) -> empty file_map -> upsert no-op.

nodes.name: Upsert File Map (Managed)
nodes.notes: ADR-061 Block 2b: persist the floor's source_ref->{url,mime} rows to agent_input_file_map so the image MCP handler resolves generate_image reference_refs WITHOUT session context (same role Upload Input Images' Upsert File Map played eagerly). Reuses that exact insert+on-conflict SQL. onError=continueErrorOutput + alwaysOutputData so a DB write failure routes to Alert File Map Failed (WARN) on the error output while the success output still feeds the session — a failed map write only degrades later reference resolution, it must NOT block the run. alwaysOutputData guarantees the success output emits an item even when 0 rows were upserted (no input images) so the session never gets skipped.

nodes.name: Alert File Map Failed
nodes.notes: ADR-061 Block 2b: a failed agent_input_file_map write silently degrades later generate_image reference_refs resolution (the agent can still answer text/embed, just can't reference-generate from input images) — fire a WARN on this side branch and reconverge to Call Execute Agent Session so the session still runs (degrade, don't break).

value.message: Nie udało się zapisać agent_input_file_map dla obrazów floora (managed) — generate_image z reference_refs może nie rozwiązać załączonych obrazów.

nodes.name: Check Spend Limit
nodes.notes: ADR-064 spend gate (single chokepoint). Runs get_spend_status(reviewer_user_id) before any spend-bearing work. Output 0 -> Spend Blocked?; error output 1 -> Alert Spend Check Failed -> Resume (FAIL-OPEN: a DB error must never freeze all agent work). Only the production When Called path is gated; the Form Trigger test path is left ungated.

nodes.name: Spend Blocked?
nodes.notes: ADR-064: $json.blocked from get_spend_status. true -> post block notice + WARN, spine does NOT run (no model spend). false -> Resume After Gate -> normal spine. The spend.enabled=false kill-switch already forces blocked=false inside the function.

nodes.name: Resume After Gate
nodes.notes: ADR-064: the Postgres gate replaces the item with the spend row, dropping the When Called fields Call Assemble Context reads ($json.taskId etc.). Restore the 7 trigger inputs here so the normal spine continues unchanged. Runs only on the When Called path (When Called is executed); the Form Trigger path stays ungated and untouched.

nodes.name: Post Block Reply
nodes.notes: ADR-064: tell the user (Polish) which cap was hit + that it resets at midnight Warsaw. Reply in-thread to triggering_comment_id; for an autonomous run with no comment, post a top-level task comment. The notice never @-tags the agent, so it can't re-trigger the producer webhook (no loop). onError continueRegularOutput so a post failure can't throw.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ comment_text: (() => { const s = $('Check Spend Limit').first().json; const r = s.block_reason; const u = Number(s.user_spend).toFixed(2), ul = Number(s.user_limit).toFixed(2), c = Number(s.company_spend).toFixed(2), cl = Number(s.company_limit).toFixed(2); if (r === 'company') return '⛔ Firmowy dzienny limit wydatków na agenta został wyczerpany (' + c + ' / ' + cl + ' PLN). Uruchomienia są wstrzymane dla wszystkich do północy (czas warszawski).'; if (r === 'both') return '⛔ Limit wydatków wyczerpany — Twój dzienny (' + u + ' / ' + ul + ' PLN) oraz firmowy (' + c + ' / ' + cl + ' PLN). Uruchomienia wstrzymane do północy (czas warszawski).'; return '⛔ Osiągnięto Twój dzienny limit wydatków na agenta (' + u + ' / ' + ul + ' PLN). Nowe uruchomienia będą blokowane do północy (czas warszawski), gdy limit się zresetuje.'; })(), notify_all: false }) }}
